dct_title_s: PRELIMINARY SATELLITE-DERIVED DAMAGE ASSESSMENT - San José Del Palmar municipality, Chocó department, Colombia
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20260810COL, GDACS ID: 1557236** SUMMARY OF FINDING Satellite imagery dated 11 August 2026 confirms visible structural damage on one building and possible debris in San José del Palmar municipality. Satellite imagery dated 11 August 2026 confirms possibly induced landslide along the departmental route, San José del Palmar-Ansermanuevo / RD48-02, in San José del Palmar municipality. No other visible widespread structural damage could be observed from satellite imagery in San José del Palmar town within the cloud-free areas as of 11 August 2026.
